events.title: Book Launch: On Un/Certainty by Natasha Lennard, In Conversation with Alice Crary
events.blurb: Journalist Natasha Lennard and philosopher Alice Crary discuss Lennard's book On Un/Certainty, examining how manufactured doubt obscures political realities around borders and systemic inequality.

events.title: Current Work | Forms of Intelligence: Labor
events.venue: The Cooper Union (Frederick P. Rose Auditorium)
events.blurb: Architect C. G. Beck and preservationist Bilge Köse join moderator Peggy Deamer at Cooper Union to examine how AI alters architectural labor and design practice.

events.title: Finnish Cultural Institute Lecture | Paulina Sawczuk: Design as an Encounter
events.blurb: Designer Paulina Sawczuk lectures in the Civic Projects Lab on contextual design methods across material craft, local culture, and built place.

events.title: What Happened to Video Art?: A Symposium on Artists’ Moving Images
events.blurb: Martha Rosler keynotes a one-day symposium with Peggy Ahwesh, Coco Fusco, Paul Pfeiffer, Alison Nguyen, and Rachel Rose on artist-run moving-image distribution.

events.title: Jan Wilker for Open Flat File
events.venue: The Cooper Union (Frederick P. Rose Auditorium)
events.blurb: Karlssonwilker co-founder Jan Wilker lectures on Karl Gerstner's Think Program and morphological boxes from the Herb Lubalin Study Center archive, with a free commemorative poster.

events.title: War Trash
events.address: 63 Fifth Ave, Lower Level, New York, NY 10003
events.blurb: Vera List Center convenes artist Aziz Hazara with Tom Keenan, Jasbir K. Puar, and Madiha Tahir to examine military debris discarded from Bagram Airfield alongside Hazara's SculptureCenter show.

events.title: Counterfictional Futures: Speculations On Biological Intelligence
events.address: 120 Walker St, 3rd Fl, New York, NY 10013
events.blurb: Tony Wang hosts contributors to the Office of Applied Strategy Dossier 3 book launch exploring speculative scenarios around biological intelligence, open-source seeds, and living systems.

events.title: Księżyc (Pioneer Works x Unsound Festival)
events.blurb: Polish avant-folk and minimalist vocal ensemble Księżyc performs live in the Pioneer Works Main Hall with collaborator Paweł Romańczuk, presented with Unsound Festival.

events.title: Trimming Phase: Book Launch & Presentation
events.blurb: Photographer Austin Aubry and publisher Off-Menu present the photobook Trimming Phase alongside a risograph print exhibition and tea tastings.

events.title: Breaking Walled Gardens
events.blurb: Hands-on permacomputing workshop where participants jailbreak older Apple iOS devices to extend hardware longevity and reduce electronic waste.

events.title: Counterfictional Futures: Speculations On Machine Intelligence
events.blurb: Part two of the Office of Applied Strategy Dossier 3 launch convenes authors to present speculative scenarios on machine intelligence and cultural foresight.

events.title: The Infinite Wager: Risk, Uncertainty, and the Philosophy of Predictive Tech
events.blurb: Interactive seminar led by Emma Stamm examining the philosophical assumptions, financial incentives, and epistemology behind predictive algorithms and forecasting tools.

events.title: Book Launch | Nolan Oswald Dennis: Ecliptics
events.blurb: Swiss Institute and The Drawing Center launch Nolan Oswald Dennis's monograph Ecliptics, surveying the artist's architectural diagrams, planetary systems drawings, and computation research.

events.title: Press Play 2026
events.blurb: Pioneer Works' seventh annual fair brings over 130 independent publishers, artist bookmakers, record labels, zines, and live radio broadcasts to Red Hook.

events.title: Wretched Mirror (Exhibition Opening)
events.blurb: Opening day of an eighteen-artist feminist group show—including Lynn Hershman Leeson, Martha Rosler, Sara Cwynar, Nikita Gale, and LaKela Brown—examining domesticity and the uncanny.

events.title: Material / Immaterial: Artists of Amos Eno Gallery (Opening Reception)
events.blurb: Opening reception at 191 Henry St for ten artists working with mineral pigments, rust, textiles, and salvaged construction debris to examine how raw matter holds memory.

events.title: Ellis & Parker von Sternberg: Normativity
events.address: 105 Henry St, Store 4 & 5, New York, NY 10002
events.blurb: Oversized moon-shaped sectional sofa sculptures fabricated in fiberglass, foam, metal, and faux leather fill the Henry Street storefront to probe luxury domestic desire.

events.title: Dani McKenzie: A Puff of Smoke
events.blurb: Thirteen oil-on-linen and board paintings by Dani McKenzie framing nocturnal New York apartment windows, fire escapes, and street-level shop counters.

events.title: Break Up
events.blurb: Thirteen-artist group show—including Alicia Gibson, Luca Buvoli, Irini Miga, and Christopher Hanrahan—installed across the two-room Monroe Street cooperative gallery, closing Dec 12.

events.title: Raúl de Nieves: The Sword, the Horse, and the Silence
events.blurb: Intricate beaded sculptures, stained-glass windows, paintings, and works on paper by Raúl de Nieves reimagining the fable of Saint George and the Dragon.

events.title: Jos Devriendt: Terra Sigillata (Exhibition Opening)
events.blurb: Opening day of Belgian ceramicist Jos Devriendt's exhibition featuring more than twenty sculptural ceramic lamps from his Night & Day series alongside earlier vessels.

events.title: Pattern Recognition: Superhouse at Five
events.blurb: Twenty-one artists—including Aspen Golann, Dan Friedman, Liz Collins, and Michele Oka Doner—present previously unshown studio craft and archival art furniture.

events.title: Misha Kahn: All Intensive Purposes
events.blurb: Experimental sculptural furniture and objects built through layered casting, improvisation, and cross-pollinated materials, closing Dec 12.

events.title: Katie Stout: Fly Trap
events.blurb: New sculptural furniture, lighting, and ornate domestic objects by Katie Stout examining growth, decay, and material accumulation over time.

events.title: Alexandre de Betak: Truss Light Sculptures 01
events.blurb: Twelve luminous industrial sculptures across two rooms transform theatrical rigging trusses and stage lights into permanent architectural fixtures.

events.title: Rafael Prieto: The Future of the Past
events.blurb: Red-lacquered birch furniture, burl-veneer tables, and stone-inlaid objects by Rafael Prieto investigating patina and urban architectural salvage, closing Dec 12.

events.title: LaJuné McMillian: To See for Oneself
events.blurb: Interactive real-time worldbuilding, AI systems, and spatial installations by LaJuné McMillian examining embodiment, collective consciousness, and ecological regeneration.

events.title: Elmgreen & Dragset: Transition
events.blurb: Near-full-scale corten steel architectural model of the White House Oval Office paired with Elmgreen & Dragset's wall-based Balcony Series examining spatial power.

events.title: Wade Guyton: Sculpture
events.blurb: Multi-part cast bronze and painted aluminum sculptures fabricated from chairs and architectural elements alongside large-scale inkjet-on-linen works.

events.title: Yoshitomo Nara
events.address: 533 West 19th St & 537 West 20th St, New York, NY 10011
events.blurb: Thirteen monumental matte urethane-coated bronze sculptural heads anchor a two-building Chelsea presentation of recent works by Yoshitomo Nara, closing Dec 12.

events.title: Cevdet Erek: Americas (with Aziz Hazara & Yining Fei)
events.address: 44-19 Purves St, Long Island City, NY 11101
events.blurb: Architectural sound-sculpture installation of steel and iron fencing with three-channel audio by Cevdet Erek, alongside commissioned rooms by Aziz Hazara and Yining Fei.

events.title: FAD Market Holiday Pop-Up | Dumbo
events.blurb: Daily curated makers market inside Empire Stores showcasing independent Brooklyn jewelers, metalsmiths, and small-batch object designers.

events.title: Hot Glass Hangout & Studio Sale with Shuhei Fujii
events.blurb: First-Friday live molten-glass blowing demonstration by artist Shuhei Fujii paired with a pop-up studio sale of community-made glass jewelry and vessels.

events.title: Renegade Craft Fair — New York Winter
events.blurb: Over 200 independent makers, studio jewelers, silversmiths, and craft studios gather across the Metropolitan Pavilion for Renegade's two-day winter fair.

events.title: Open Studios: Winter in the City
events.blurb: Open-house access across UrbanGlass's 17,000-square-foot studio with live flameworking, neon bending, glassblowing demos, and hands-on beadmaking and fusing sessions.

events.title: Grand Bazaar NYC: Saturday Holiday Market & Jewelry Showcase
events.blurb: Special Saturday holiday market featuring an independent jewelry designer showcase alongside local makers and craft studios indoors and outdoors on West 77th Street.

events.title: UrbanSparkle 2026
events.blurb: Annual exhibition of wearable glass and enameled metalwork featuring contemporary art jewelry by Danielle Embry, Meghan Schmiedel, Myriam Saavedra, and Tanya Crane.
events.hours: Tue–Sat 11 AM–7 PM, Sun 11 AM–5 PM
